actions: Resolved and froze sanitized repository control with two matching SHA-only main-ref lookups before semantic work.
Continued the own long-horizon selector-harness frontier from the latest pointer.
Inspected primary papers and released public code for learned/meta-agent fork selection, matched-budget counterfactual branching, causal suffix replay, and inference-state checkpointing.
Verified in Shepherd's released SWE-Bench runner that post-intervention step budget is computed as global step_limit minus fork_step, independently reproducing the rollback-depth budget confound.
Checkpointed new findings and advanced the own LATEST pointer without reading the shared execution ledger or other-role receipts.
new_findings_summary: Shepherd supplies a concrete agent-selected historical fork selector but jointly changes target and hint/carry-forward.
Shepherd's released SWE-V runner has a target-depth-dependent post-intervention step budget, so its target-selection results are not selector-only under equal remaining resources.

Counterfactual Recoverability supplies matched remaining-budget branch construction plus explicit ambiguity/abstention and probe/held-out separation, but only for continue-vs-rollback formal reasoning.
CRO supplies first-causally-affected-event replay and fix/guard regression accounting as candidate primitives, not a solved generic recovery selector.
Concordia narrows the full-inference-state restoration substrate search but does not prove semantic branch equivalence.
termination_cause: checkpoint boundary reached with nonempty research frontier; not global completion
exact_next_action: Factor Shepherd's fork-step selector from its target-specific hint, enumerate all target-correlated variables, then search for software/tool-agent experiments with equal post-intervention action/token/retry budgets across multiple historical targets; preserve the strict selector-only gap unless all non-target variables are fixed.
